messages:
Alex L.: Heads-up — master CI started failing right after the toolchain roll. Configure step hits an unknown CMake command error: 'Unknown CMake command "my_config_header"'. Failing job: linux-cmake-config. CI link: https://ci.redwood.example/job/12345 :eyes:

Maria G.: ugh, saw that. Is it the macro from the internal utils cmake module? can you paste the configure log?

Alex L.: Paste below (truncated):
```
-- Configuring done
CMake Error at cmake/modules/FindRedwood.cmake:42 (my_config_header):
  Unknown CMake command "my_config_header".
Call Stack (most recent call first):
  CMakeLists.txt:12 (include)
```

Samir K.: looks like a macro from the old redwood-cmake-tooling. The toolchain roll may have switched the CMAKE_MODULE_PATH or removed an include. Can you repro locally with the same toolchain image?

Alex L.: Trying now with the new image: `docker run --rm -v $PWD:/src redwood-toolchain:2026 /bin/bash -c "mkdir build && cd build && cmake .."` — I get the same error.

Jia Chen: quick check — does cmake/modules/RedwoodMacros.cmake still define `my_config_header()`? maybe file renamed. Grep for definition: `grep -R "function(my_config_header" -n cmake || true`

Alex L.: grep returns nothing. The file `cmake/modules/RedwoodMacros.cmake` exists but it's missing that function. Diffing against last release tag shows the function was removed in the toolchain roll commit `toolchain/2026-roll` (cc @Samir K.).

Samir K.: yep that roll included a refactor that moved some macros into a separate package `redwood-cmake-extras` and I forgot to wire up the module path in the top-level CMakeLists. Bad. Quick options: 1) revert the specific toolchain commit (fast but noisy), 2) add a compatibility shim in cmake/modules that re-exports the macro, or 3) update top-level CMake to include the new package (preferred).

Maria G.: for CI unblock, can we land option 2 (shim) as a tiny hotfix so teams can keep working, then follow up with a proper package include?

Samir K.: +1 for shim. Minimal patch: `cmake/modules/compat-myconfig.cmake` with:
```
if(NOT COMMAND my_config_header)
  function(my_config_header ARG)
    include(${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/../redwood-cmake-extras/MyConfigHeader.cmake)
  endfunction()
endif()
```
I can push a PR in a few mins.

Alex L.: That would be great. If you push, I'll trigger a rerun of the failing CI job.

ci-bot: Build rerun scheduled: https://ci.redwood.example/job/12345/console (rerun by Alex L.) :white_check_mark:

Maria G.: also adding a short note to the toolchain-roll PR so the owner can follow up to set CMAKE_MODULE_PATH in the image.

Samir K.: PR opened: https://git.redwood.example/infra/infra-config/pull/789 — added compat shim and a short test that calls `my_config_header()` during configure.

Alex L.: CI rerun (job 12346) is green on configure stage, looks like the shim worked. running full pipeline now. :thumbsup:

Jia Chen: nice. let's schedule a follow-up to update the toolchain image to include the new package and add an integration test to catch this in future rolls.

Samir K.: filing follow-up ticket: INFRA-3123 (update toolchain image + add smoke test).

Alex L.: thanks all. marking this triaged — will keep an eye if anything else pops up.

Maria G.: thanks Samir for the quick fix. :tada:
